labels.on_dark_info: Turn on when this block sits on the dark hero band or another dark background.
labels.heading: Heading
labels.heading_em_info: Shown on its own line, in italic serif and the primary colour (e.g. "Her legacy," / "carried on.").
labels.sizes_attribute_info: Advanced: the responsive `sizes` value passed to the image. Leave the default unless this image never fills the viewport width.
labels.alt_text_info: Leave empty to use the image's alt text from Settings → Files.

heading_tag.h1: H1 (page title — use once per page)

loading.priority: Priority (the LCP image — max one per page)

brand.name: Logo and brand
brand.logo_info: Leave empty to use the built-in bronze Kambric Goods wordmark. Upload a transparent PNG or SVG, at least 600px wide.
brand.favicon_info: Square image, at least 96 × 96px. Leave empty to use the built-in Kambric icon.
brand.share_image_info: Used when a page has no image of its own (e.g. links shared to Instagram, iMessage or Pinterest). 1200 × 630px recommended.
brand.google_site_verification_info: Only the content value from Google's HTML-tag method (not the whole <meta> tag). Added to the home page only.

colors.name: Colors
colors.info: Defaults match the current kambricgoods.com palette. Change with care: text colors must stay readable on their backgrounds.

announcement.name: Announcement bar
announcement.cta_label_info: Underlined text after the message (hidden on small phones). Needs a link.
announcement.style_info: The current site uses Static. Scrolling pauses on hover and is turned off for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

header.menu_info: Top-level links become the header navigation. Links nested under a top-level link become its dropdown. A dropdown made only of collections uses the large italic style.

brand.name: Brand text and social
brand.show_social_info: Links come from Theme settings → Social media.

menu.name: Menu column
menu.heading: Heading
menu.heading_info: Leave empty to use the menu's own title.

newsletter.name: Newsletter signup
newsletter.heading: Heading
newsletter.info: Sign-ups are saved as customers tagged "newsletter" with email marketing consent (Customers in the Shopify admin).

main_product.name: Product
main_product.show_breadcrumbs_info: Search engines still get the breadcrumb trail when hidden.
main_product.show_print_tag: Show the print name on the image

collection_hero.name: Collection header
collection_hero.show_on_info: This section also sits on the default collection template, which Shop (/collections/all) uses too. Leave this on "every collection except /collections/all" so it stays silent there and catalog-heading/category-nav show instead.
collection_hero.show_image_info: Uses, in order: this collection's Header image field, then its Card image field, then its Shopify collection image, then no image (text-only header).
collection_hero.show_breadcrumbs_info: The small Home › Collections › … trail above the title. Search engines get the trail either way.
collection_hero.show_season_info: From this collection's Season and Year fields, e.g. "Fall 2024". Hidden automatically when neither is set.

catalog_heading.name: Catalog heading
catalog_heading.title: Title
catalog_heading.title_info: Leave blank to use this collection's title (on /collections/all: "All" / "Pieces").
catalog_heading.intro_info: Leave blank to use this collection's description (not shown on /collections/all when blank).
catalog_heading.product_type_filter_info: Advanced: leave blank unless the product grid below applies an extra product-type filter this count needs to match.
catalog_heading.intro_length_info: "First sentence" keeps the top of the page short; add the "About this collection" section below the products to show the full description there.

category_nav.name: Category strip
category_nav.menu_info: Top-level links only. "All" should point to /collections/all, then one link per category collection. Create this menu first (default handle: shop-categories) — see the content guide.

main_collections.name: Collections index
main_collections.collection_list_info: Leave empty to show every collection that has a Season set (the current chapters: Folklore, Psychedelics, Whimsy). Category and Sale collections never appear here by default.

modes.content: Add a Collection block for each group to list cards grouped by collection (shop and category pages). With no blocks, the section shows a single grid (collection and sale pages).

show_on.label: Show on
show_on.info: The shop page is /collections/all, which uses the default collection template. "Shop page only" shows this section there; "All collections except the shop page" hides it there.

options.except_all: All collections except the shop page

pinned_products.label: Show these first
pinned_products.info: These products lead the list (and every group they appear in), in this order, when they're on the page. Leave empty to keep the collection's sort order.

products_per_page.label: Products per page
products_per_page.info: Products, not cards: a product with several prints shows one card per print, so the number of cards per page varies.

eager_count.label: Cards to load first
eager_count.info: The first row of cards loads immediately; the rest load as shoppers scroll. Keep this at 3 (one row on desktop).

show_other.label: Show other pieces
show_other.info: Lists, after the groups, every print whose collection has no block (e.g. a new collection you haven't added yet), so nothing disappears. Only used when the section has Collection blocks.

other_heading.label: Heading for other pieces
other_heading.info: Leave empty to show them without a heading (like the current site).

match_collection.label: Only prints from this collection
match_collection.info: A product with several prints shows only the prints that belong to this collection. Turn off on the sale template.

print_filter.label: Show
print_filter.info: "Prints on sale" keeps only prints with a compare-at price above the price. Each print qualifies on its own.

label.label: Label above the grid
label.info: E.g. "The Pieces". Leave empty to hide.

card_layout.label: Card style
card_layout.info: Grouped listings always use the Archive style.

structured_data.label: Describe the list for search engines
structured_data.info: Adds structured data listing every card on the page. Leave on.

product_type.label: Only this product type
product_type.info: For testing a category on /collections/all, e.g. Dresses. Leave empty on real pages.

collection.label: Collection
collection.info: Shows the page's prints that belong to this collection. Drag blocks to change the order. Groups with no pieces are hidden.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Leave empty to use the collection's title.

main_page.eyebrow_info: Shown above the page title, e.g. "Say Hello", "For Stockists".

main_article.product_list_info: Optional. Shown under the post body. Leave empty to show nothing — there's no automatic fallback (the source's Markdown-link parser wasn't ported; none of the 5 migrated posts have product links anyway).

size_table.name: Size table
size_table.fit_note_cta_url_info: e.g. mailto:howdy@kambricgoods.com, or a page/collection link.

image.info: Optional. With no image, the hero shows as a text-only band on the dark background — no broken layout.

heading_line_2.label: Heading line 2 (accent)
heading_line_2.info: Shown in italic and the primary/gold colour, on its own line.

image_position.label: Image side (desktop)
image_position.info: On mobile the photo always appears above the text, regardless of this setting.

heading.label: Heading
heading.info: Press Enter for a second line, like the source's "It began with / the archive."

past_limit.label: Past events to show
past_limit.info: Caps the past list, most recent first. The old site kept 4.

show_design_mode_sample.label: Show sample events in the editor
show_design_mode_sample.info: Only visible while you're editing this theme in Customize; shoppers never see it. Turn this on to check the layout before any real events exist.

image.label: Photo
image.info: The page's main image; it loads first. Use a wide landscape photo at least 2400 px wide. Without a photo, the dark hero band shows on its own.

mobile_image.label: Phone photo (optional)
mobile_image.info: Shown on screens narrower than 768 px. Use a portrait crop so the subject stays in frame. Leave empty to use the main photo.

image_alt.label: Alt text
image_alt.info: Leave empty if the photo is decorative (the headline already says what it shows). Otherwise describe the photo for screen readers and image search.

image_position.label: Crop position
image_position.info: Which part of the photo stays in view when it's cropped, as "horizontal vertical" (e.g. "center 25%" keeps the upper quarter). A focal point set on the image in Content → Files takes priority.

overlay_strength.label: Shading
overlay_strength.info: The warm tint and the darker top, bottom and text-side shading that keep the text readable. 100% matches the current site.

title.label: Headline
title.info: This is the page's main heading (H1) for search engines. If both headline lines are empty, the shop name is used for screen readers.

title_size.label: Headline size
title_size.info: Medium suits a product name ("Arielle Slip Dress"); Large suits a short phrase.

cta2_label.label: Second link label
cta2_label.info: Shown as text with an arrow (→).

items.label: Items
items.info: One per line. They scroll in a loop, separated by ✦. Screen readers hear each item once.

duration.label: Speed
duration.info: Seconds for one loop. Higher is slower. The current site uses 28 s (top strip) and 32 s (bottom strip).

heading_em.label: Italic word
heading_em.info: Shown in italic right after the heading, on the same line (e.g. "From the" + "Collections").

source.label: Fill with
source.info: Flagged pieces fill the slots the "Show first" blocks leave free. Flags are set per print in the product's Prints data, or with the tags featured / new-arrival on single-print products.

collection.label: From collection
collection.info: Leave empty to use every product (listed alphabetically). With a collection, its sort order applies.

match_collection.label: Only prints from this collection
match_collection.info: For Folklore, Psychedelics or Whimsy: a product with several prints shows only the prints that belong to the collection. Leave off for category collections.

exclude_types.label: Exclude product types
exclude_types.info: Comma-separated product types to leave out of the flagged pieces, e.g. "Swimwear". "Show first" blocks are never excluded.

pinned_position.label: Show first pieces go
pinned_position.info: Their slots are always kept: flagged pieces only fill what's left of the maximum.

max_count.label: Maximum cards
max_count.info: Counts cards, not products: each print is its own card.

print.label: Print (optional)
print.info: Exact print or colourway name, e.g. "Matyó Floral". Leave empty to show every print of the product. If the product doesn't have this print, the block is skipped.

body.label: Text
body.info: Keep it to two short paragraphs, as on the current site.

image.info: The first photo is the tall one on the left of the collage; the next two stack on the right. Up to three.

position.label: Crop position
position.info: Which part of the photo stays in view when it's cropped, as "horizontal vertical" (e.g. "center 25%" keeps the upper quarter). A focal point set on the image in Content → Files takes priority.

image.label: Background photo (optional)
image.info: Shown faded behind the quote. Without a photo the band is plain.

wash_strength.label: Cream wash
wash_strength.info: A layer of the page background over the photo to keep the quote readable. 60% matches the current site.

heading_em.label: Italic word
heading_em.info: Shown in italic right after the heading (e.g. "In the" + "field.").

intro.label: Intro
intro.info: One short line, shown on the right on desktop only.

position.label: Crop position
position.info: Which part of the photo stays in view when it's cropped, as "horizontal vertical" (e.g. "center 25%" keeps the upper quarter). A focal point set on the image in Content → Files takes priority.

link_label.label: Link description
link_label.info: Read by screen readers, e.g. "Shop the Vera Car Coat". Leave empty to use the caption.

main_cart.heading: Heading
main_cart.empty_link_info: Leave empty to link to all products.

newsletter_popup.name: Newsletter pop-up
newsletter_popup.heading: Heading
newsletter_popup.discount_code_info: Shown only after a successful sign-up. The code must exist as an active discount in Shopify before launch (owner task, see OWNER_TASKS 🔴). Leave this blank to hide the code line entirely — e.g. if a Shopify Email automation sends the code by email instead (decision D-11).

collection_about.name: About this collection
collection_about.heading: Heading
collection_about.heading_info: Leave blank for "About our [collection name]". Shows the collection's description; hidden when it has none.
